description: PN-Chord expands Probably Not(e) and goes immediately to its right; while one voice is quantised, its QUANT CV then carries a four-note chord on the chosen note, from notes of the key and scale.

params.text: Sets the chance that the fifth of the chord is diminished or augmented, 0 to 100%.
An attenuverter, -100% to +100%, scaling the voltage at the input it belongs with before that voltage is added to the knob's own setting.
Sets the chance that the seventh of the chord is diminished or augmented, 0 to 100%.
Sets the chance that the third of the chord is replaced by a suspended second or fourth, 0 to 100%.

inputs.text: Voltage here is added to the probability set by the knob it belongs with, 0-10V through that knob's attenuverter.
Takes the random number behind that decision from this voltage, 0-10V, instead of the module's own.
